title: Efficient Dense Crowd Trajectory Prediction Via Dynamic Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2603.18166v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Crowd trajectory prediction plays a crucial role in public safety and management, where it can help prevent disasters such as stampedes. Recent works address the problem by predicting individual trajectories and considering surrounding objects based on manually annotated data. However, these approaches tend to overlook dense crowd scenarios, where the challenges of automation become more pronounced due to the massiveness, noisiness, and inaccuracy of the tracking outputs, resulting in high computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose and extensively evaluate a novel cluster-based approach that groups individuals based on similar attributes over time, enabling faster execution through accurate group summarisation. Our plug-and-play method can be combined with existing trajectory predictors by using our output centroid in place of their pedestrian input. We evaluate our proposed method on several challenging dense crowd

translated_title: 基于动态聚类的高效密集人群轨迹预测
translated_abstract: 人群轨迹预测在公共安全和管理中发挥着至关重要的作用，可以帮助预防踩踏等灾害。近期的工作通过基于人工标注数据预测个体轨迹并考虑周围物体来解决这一问题。然而，这些方法往往忽视了密集人群场景，在此类场景中，由于跟踪输出的规模庞大、噪声多且不准确，自动化的挑战变得更加突出，并导致高昂的计算成本。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出并广泛评估了一种新颖的基于聚类的方法，该方法根据相似属性随时间对个体进行分组，通过准确的群体摘要实现更快的执行速度。我们的即插即用方法可以与现有轨迹预测器结合使用，用我们输出的质心代替其行人输入。我们在多个具有挑战性的密集人群（场景）上评估了所提出的方法
tldr: 提出一种基于动态聚类的即插即用方法，通过按相似属性对人群分组并用群体质心代替个体输入，显著提升密集人群轨迹预测的计算效率。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel plug-and-play dynamic clustering approach that groups pedestrians by similar attributes over time and replaces individual inputs with group centroids, enabling efficient trajectory prediction in dense crowd scenarios.
